spans.s: rākā-śaśāṅka (SII 1), same as rākā-viṭa; the full-moon.
rakata-paṭā (JBORS, Vol. XVIII, pp. 219-20), Od̤iyā; Sanskrit rakta-paṭṭaka, same as rakta-mānya; also called sira-kaṭā tambā-paṭā in Od̤iyā.
rākā-viṭa (SII 1), same as rākā-śaśāṅka; the full moon.
rakṣā (EI 17), confirmation of a former grant.

rakṣā-bhoga (EI 9), same as rāja-bhoga, the king's share.
 (SITI), a fee or a share in the produce given to the village watchman.
rakṣaṇa, cf. doṣa-vināś-āvaṣṭabdhi-rakṣaṇāya (LP), ‘for keeping it safe from the three faults, viz. doṣa, vināśa and avaṣṭabdhi’.

rakta-mānya, cf. Tamil iratta-mānya, iratta-kkāṇikkai (SITI); ‘blood-present’; endowment of rent-free land for the support of the descendants of warriors killed in battle; same as mṛtyuka-vṛtti. See rudhira, rakatapaṭā, vīra-śeṣā, etc. See Ind. Arch. Rev., 1960-61, Section III,
raktikā (IA 27), same as ratī or guñjā (q. v.); a unit of measurment; about 1-825 grains or 119 grammes in weight.
raktikā , modern rati; a little above 1(3/4) grains.
